general: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Implement the 'Navy' theme strictly. Do not use Teal or Purple.
Use the 'Bento' grid layout for the dashboard.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use 'recharts' for all charts (Bar, Line, Pie).
Implement the RCA Wizard as a multi-step form with a progress indicator.
Ensure the sidebar is collapsible and responsive.

pages.login: Use the industrial plant image as a full-screen background with a dark overlay. Center the login card with glassmorphism effect.
pages.dashboard: Create a high-density grid. Top row: 4 KPI cards. Middle row: 2 Charts (Audit Trends, Compliance by Dept). Bottom row: Recent Findings Table.
pages.rca_wizard: Use a horizontal stepper. Step 1: Problem Definition. Step 2: 5-Why Analysis (dynamic inputs). Step 3: Fishbone (visual selector). Step 4: Root Cause Confirmation.
pages.audit_findings: Use a data table with filters for Status, Risk Level, and Department. Add a 'New Finding' button that opens a slide-over or modal.

accessibility: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios.
Use semantic HTML (main, nav, aside, section).
Ensure keyboard navigation works for all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly (only for overlays/toasts).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
